FedLeave Calendar

Version 0.2.0

FedLeave Calendar is a PySide6 desktop interface for the fedleave backend bundle.

I wrote fedleave as a backend for an AI agent and dashboard so I could experiment with leave tracking in a way that felt practical for my own use.

This started as a 100% at-home vibe coding experiment. It is a single-user tool, and I would not use it for anything critical.

The application displays month data returned by the fedleave executable and sends write operations back through that executable. It also launches chart companion apps from the View > Leave Charts submenu. In packaged builds, the GUI and backend live in separate application directories inside the same platform tree.
